_doc: Single source of truth for ALL stock-type detector thresholds. Read by BOTH algo-engine/screener/stock_types.py (backtest + daemon) and services/alpha/StockTypeClassifier.ts (live UI). Every threshold maps to a sentence in docs/algo/strategy_brief.md. Tune only via the backtest report in docs/algo/stock_type_backtest_report.md.

type1_accumulator._doc: Silent Accumulator (PCJEWELLER). EVIDENCE 2026-09: no directional edge. Full spec measured excess -0.115% (t=-2.76); 'near day low' is the harmful component. Demoted to WATCH-ONLY: still labelled in the UI for learning, but never auto-surfaced as a trade candidate.

type2_exhaustion_trap._doc: Exhaustion Trap (ADFFOODS). EVIDENCE 2026-09: the VOLUME leg is REAL and robust - first-15m volume >= 8x normal gives excess -0.166% (t=-2.93, 40.6% positive, negative in all 4 years). The GAP leg was WRONG: a 3% gap is mildly BULLISH (+0.110%, t=+2.26); only gaps > 5% behave as traps (-0.174%). Volume is now the sole (OR) trigger; gap threshold raised to 5%.

type3_pullback_continue._doc: Pullback-and-Continue (RITES). EVIDENCE 2026-09: coin flip. All variants measured |excess| < 0.006% with |t| < 1.1 (n=18k-35k). Demoted to WATCH-ONLY.

type4_front_loaded._doc: Front-Loaded Exhaustion: 80%+ of expected daily range in first 20 min. EVIDENCE 2026-09: em_coverage alone showed no edge (+0.022%, decile spread 0.029 - weakest feature scanned). Retained as a block only in combination with the validated volume spike; no longer blocks on em_coverage alone.

type5_gap_freeze._doc: Gap-Up-Then-Freeze (BHARATSE). EVIDENCE 2026-09: only 4 samples in the backtest - far too few to judge. Kept as WATCH-ONLY so samples accumulate.

fno1_hod_exhaustion_short._doc: F&O: sitting at/near day high after a big move. EVIDENCE 2026-09: no short edge (excess +0.039%, t=+0.98). Demoted to WATCH-ONLY.

fno2_vwap_snapback_short._doc: F&O: far above VWAP near day high. EVIDENCE 2026-09: no edge (-0.031%, t=-0.92); a short pays cost on top. Demoted to WATCH-ONLY.

fno3_gap_exhaustion_short._doc: F&O: big gap up, surge done. EVIDENCE 2026-09: gap 3-5% measured mildly BULLISH; only >5% showed trap behaviour on the cash side. No confirmed short edge - WATCH-ONLY.

fno4_accumulation_long._doc: F&O accumulation LONG (cash Type 1 applied to F&O universe). EVIDENCE 2026-09: inherits Type 1's lack of edge. WATCH-ONLY.

risk._doc_trade_sim: Stop/target distances as fractions of PRIOR-DAY daily ATR (d_atr14). Conservative: if a bar touches both, it counts as a stop.
